Asturian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin adolēscēns.

Adjective

[edit]

adolescente (epicene, plural adolescentes)

  1. adolescent (characteristic of adolescence)

Noun

[edit]

adolescente m or f (plural adolescentes)

  1. adolescent

Related terms

[edit]
  • adolescencia

French

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /a.dɔ.lɛ.sɑ̃t/ ~ /a.dɔ.le.sɑ̃t/
  • Audio:(file)

Adjective

[edit]

adolescente

  1. feminine singular of adolescent

Galician

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Learned borrowing from Latin adolēscentem.

Adjective

[edit]

adolescente m or f (plural adolescentes)

  1. adolescent, teenage

Noun

[edit]

adolescente m or f by sense (plural adolescentes)

  1. adolescent, teenager (child aged between thirteen and nineteen)

Related terms

[edit]
  • adolescencia

Further reading

[edit]
  • “adolescente”, in Dicionario da Real Academia Galega (in Galician), A Coruña: Royal Galician Academy, 2012–2026

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin adolēscentem.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /a.do.leʃˈʃɛn.te/[1]
    • Rhymes: -ɛnte
    • Hyphenation: a‧do‧le‧scèn‧te
  • IPA(key): (regional) /a.do.leʃˈʃen.te/
    • Audio:(file)
    • Rhymes: -ente
    • Hyphenation: a‧do‧le‧scén‧te

Adjective

[edit]

adolescente m or f by sense (plural adolescenti)

  1. adolescent

Noun

[edit]

adolescente m or f by sense (plural adolescenti)

  1. adolescent, teenager

Related terms

[edit]
  • adolescenza

References

[edit]
  1. ^ adolescente in Luciano Canepari, Dizionario di Pronuncia Italiana (DiPI)

Further reading

  • adolescente in Treccani.it – Vocabolario Treccani on line, Istituto dell'Enciclopedia Italiana

Latin

[edit]

Pronunciation

  • (Classical Latin) IPA(key): [a.dɔ.ɫeːsˈkɛn.tɛ]
  • (modern Italianate Ecclesiastical) IPA(key): [a.do.leʃˈʃɛn.te]

adolescente m or f (plural adolescentes)

Adjective

adolescente m or f (masculine and feminine plural adolescentes)
